usageNotes: Use this endpoint to confirm the running Proxmox Datacenter Manager version before scripting against version-specific behavior or after an upgrade. No parameters are required, and any authenticated user (including API tokens) can call it. Returns immediately with no async task.
tips: Returns three fields: version (e.g. '0.5.1'), release (package release tag), and repoid (git commit hash) — use repoid to pinpoint the exact build when filing bug reports.
This endpoint is the lightest possible health/connectivity check: if it succeeds, the PDM API is reachable and credentials are valid.
